V7 sparkling drinks, made in Egypt, have just arrived in Australia!

These drinks are halal, low-calorie, made with natural flavours and contain no caffeine..

The packaging is soo smart 👏 The can cover keeps the top clean and hygienic, and it’s practical if you need to put it down and come back to it..

With Ramadan coming up, it works really well on the iftar table - light on sugar, refreshing after a long fast, and easy to serve for family and guests. You can have it chilled straight from the can or turn it into a simple mocktail 🍹
